item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs khro bo rtsod pa zlog pa'i 'khor lo las go cha dbal gyi tan tra
gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs khro bo rtsod pa zlog pa'i 'khor lo las go cha dbal gyi tan tra
item.coloph: go cha dbal gyi tan tra/ stag la me 'bar gyi spyi sdoms su gsungs pas/ lha klu mi gsum snang mdog dang bzhi la brgyud do/ des lho yi gshen gsum/ des zhang zhung gshen gsum/ des rgya bod sgom gshen gsum/ des phrom bod zhang zhung gshen gsum/ des se lde me gsum/ des dran pa nam mkha'/ des rje blon ldong gsum ra song khod ram/ mu spangs gsal tang la gdams pa'o/ des phyi rabs las ldan gyi gshen (mchan mu la rad Na) la gdams pa'o//
